I004.desc: A night's rest in the open: restores the whole party's HP and MP. Not usable in dangerous places.
I004.name: Travel Tent

I016.desc: A Kuni field draught, bitter and hot. Wakes a fallen ally with half their HP.
I016.name: Revival Draught

I019.desc: Cures poison, paralysis, blindness and sealing.
I019.name: Panacea

I100.desc: A Wall ration wrapped in leaves. Restores some HP.
I100.name: Rice Ball

I101.desc: Bitter green paste. Restores a good deal of HP.
I101.name: Herbal Salve

I102.desc: Two zeni, or one if you smile.
I102.name: Salt Herring

I104.desc: A pinch of powdered jade. Burns the Tainted (Jade damage).
I104.name: Jade Dust

I110.desc: A child's signal mirror, found in the Egg Caves. Return it in Hoshi-no-Ichi.
I110.name: Kite Mirror

I111.desc: A carved fish with careful fins. Gonta's boy made it.
I111.name: Wooden Fish

I112.desc: A cheap, pretty hairpin. Kiyo's, by the look of it.
I112.name: Pearl Hairpin

I113.desc: A shugenja's field scroll (Water). Haruki can learn it.
I113.name: Scroll: Summon Fog

I114.desc: Daubed with a child's nightmare. Cracking it cures Silence. (Ryozo's)
I114.name: Painted Egg

I460.desc: Pungent salts in a twist of paper. Wakes a fallen ally with a quarter of their HP.
I460.name: Smelling Salts

I461.desc: A sealed lacquer vial from a Fortune's shrine. Wakes a fallen ally with all their HP. Rare: no merchant sells it.
I461.name: Breath of Jurojin

I190.desc: A bitter root tonic from the year-400 market. Restores most of your HP.
I190.name: Ginseng Tonic

I115.desc: No egg. Just the drop. Very pure. Very Crab. Kiyo's thank-you.
I115.name: Drop Soup

I116.desc: A carved fish, the twin of the one you returned. Gonta will come once if you ask (Crab Ch2).
I116.name: Hidden Ones' Thanks

I117.desc: Glossy and black. The kite child swears it brings luck. Merchants pay a little.
I117.name: Crow Feather

I120.desc: Takakana's third flare. Blue: something none of us has seen before.
I120.name: Blue Flare

I121.desc: From the troll's chains. The cut is clean and bright: a rasp, not a struggle.
I121.name: Filed Chain Link

I122.desc: From Kuhime's room. Silk from the Crane coast, not the Phoenix.
I122.name: Blue-Silk Veil Thread

I123.desc: Keiyomi's ribbon from the Tunnel of Quiescent Flame.
I123.name: Unicorn Dance Ribbon

I124.desc: A forge-master's plan. Sells for a fortune, or trade it at a Kaiu forge.
I124.name: Kaiu Tetsubo Blueprint

I140.desc: Heaven's Glory Reflected in the Soul's Steel: a Kakita wakizashi. Look at it and you measure yourself against the ideal samurai. (Key item)
I140.name: Heaven's Glory

I141.desc: Lord Goroso's taxes on the village, year by year. They have tripled.
I141.name: Pleasant Eaves Tax Ledger

I142.desc: A letter inside, to his mother. Never sent.
I142.name: Morishu's Inro

I143.desc: The harbour master's chart: the land-bridge is open at low tide, dawn and dusk.
I143.name: Tide Chart

I144.desc: From Chihaya's sash: a Lion patron pays the White Squid to bleed the Crane coast. Signed Matsu Tadanobu.
I144.name: Tadanobu's Letters

I145.desc: The stolen tribute: a lacquered screen for the Emperor's winter palace. Slightly damp.
I145.name: The Emperor's Screen

I147.desc: A noh play, banned four hundred years. Written by "a survivor of the court of Komatsu". It knows Doji Nashiko's weaknesses. (Key item)
I147.name: The Empress of Nothing

I149.desc: Misfiled for four centuries. It mentions "the bride who never blinked".
I149.name: Komatsu's Steward's Diary

I151.desc: From the tea house's back room: troop counts on Lord Hiruto's border, in a Crane hand.
I151.name: Crane Spy's Note

I152.desc: Isawa Hoju forged them to bind O-Tamai. The lock grows cold when it faces the spirit. (Key item: a compass)
I152.name: Jade Chains

I155.desc: O-Tamai's ring, slid off a borrowed finger. Cold, and it hums. (Lore)
I155.name: Bloodspeaker's Ring

I157.desc: The painting contest's prize: a scroll in a judge's hand, praising a snowflake on a sword blade.
I157.name: Scroll of Acclaim

I158.desc: Letters between Akodo Kafu and Akodo Nishi. The oni read them aloud in his own voice.
I158.name: Kafu's Love Letters

I159.desc: Toturi's message for the old man of Kaze-no-Tani, sealed with the Champion's mon. Cracked by the cold. "Kill these messengers."
I159.name: The Lacquered Tube

I160.desc: A Miya travel writ, and a letter to a Crane general in the same hand: "the Lion will attack at the river by the next moon". The Lion have no such plan.
I160.name: Miya Letters

I164.desc: Matsu Rokuro's own sword-knot, given in the shallows. "I was so frightened. Thank you."
I164.name: Rokuro's Gratitude

I165.desc: A charred crate lid from the Magonojo warehouses, stamped with Crane army supply marks. The Phoenix were feeding the Crane.
I165.name: Stamped Crate Lid

I166.desc: Isawa Hoju's unfinished history of a family that doesn't want one. "In the third year, the family's shugenja bound a grave evil in the west."
I166.name: Hoju's History

I167.desc: A child's folded note from under the Jade Chains, in Haruki's own handwriting. He hasn't unfolded it.
I167.name: A Folded Note

I169.desc: Ikoma Sadahisa's scroll: an undying dark side of the Phoenix, reborn in its greatest shugenja. Written in fear, by a gentle hand: Mieko's.
I169.name: "The Consumer"

I171.desc: An Isawa field scroll from the treaty archive: Tremor shakes loose what is stuck in stone. (Field spell)
I171.name: Scroll: Tremor

I172.desc: From the Silent Court's masters, for the boy who refused to forget. Haruki knows the spell now.
I172.name: Scroll: Courage of the Seven Thunders

I173.desc: A dying healer's scroll. "It won't cure this. It'll teach you what cure means." Haruki knows the spell now.
I173.name: Scroll: Hand of Jurojin

I174.desc: A secret of Air from Isawa Uona: walking in another's dreams. "I think you'll need it soon."
I174.name: Scroll: Dreamwalker

I176.desc: A black go stone from Mieko's childhood room. A captured stone, once.
I176.name: A Child's Go Stone

I178.desc: Kitsuki Oharu's magistrate seal, pressed into a junior yoriki's hand. "They won't respect it in your hands. Use it anyway."
I178.name: Oharu's Seal

I179.desc: A ferry token for Tortoise Island, from the beach. Kumpei's sail went that way.
I179.name: Tortoise Ferry Token

I180.desc: Oiled paper from the hollow in the Gusai wall: "Ayaru. Then Jotaro. Then Nobue. Each of us has followed the old man." Togashi Akuro.
I180.name: The Monks' Notes

I181.desc: From Kakita Kumpei's paint box: the same rare blue as the stolen tattoos' ink.
I181.name: Rare Blue Pigment

I182.desc: Dragon work, Tamori-style: an alembic from the new house on Tortoise Island. Our own clan's tools, in a murderer's kitchen.
I182.name: Tamori Alembic

I183.desc: A Dragon star-chart from the new house, marked in an old man's hand: dates, not stars. A map of when.
I183.name: Brass Star-chart

I184.desc: From the paint scraps in the cove: a pot of the same rare blue, still wet. It moves when you aren't looking.
I184.name: Kumpei's Ink Pot

I187.desc: The old Mirumoto's short blade. "Clerks know the second stroke corrects the first." (Daisho Technique)
I187.name: Koshi's Wakizashi

I188.desc: Three lacquered invitations from three gozoku lords. Three dinners, all at the same hour.
I188.name: Three Invitations

I189.desc: Small silvered mirrors, bought back from Kakita Miyoshi. They won't exist here for two hundred years. (She kept one.)
I189.name: Gaijin Mirrors

I191.desc: Doji Tomeko's gift: a fan painted with the Crane's first wards. Lore, and worth a great deal to a collector.
I191.name: Crane Ward Fan

I193.desc: Gendo's copy of the coast burned into Shiro Izumida's floor: landing points, dates, arrows. An invasion plan.
I193.name: The Scorched Map

I194.desc: The last vial of kami-ichor (Togashi's blood), saved from Kumpei's hip before it went over the rail.
I194.name: The Kami-ichor Vial

I195.desc: Iron. Plain. A finger long. It once held the heart of Iuchiban, and it hums like a heartbeat through a wall. No tool we own can break it. (Cursed: Mitsue starts every battle with no Void)
I195.name: The Iron Box

I196.desc: A blood-red jasper scorpion. Shosuro Norie owes the bearer one impossible thing. Forgeries shorten lives.
I196.name: Scorpion "Favor"

I401.desc: Miya Hatomu's map of a city that didn't exist. Every street. Every one.
I401.name: Hatomu's Map

I402.desc: Rolled up inside Giseiki's mask: travel papers under the chop of a Scorpion lord three hundred years dead.
I402.name: Antique Travel Papers

I403.desc: A ceramic bell the size of a baby's fist, with no clapper. Gochu was paid five koku to shake it whenever Akodo Rin was alone.
I403.name: The Clapperless Bell

I404.desc: Folded very small. "...the war was set moving from Kyuden Bayushi. By the Champion's own hand. A distraction." Tell no one.
I404.name: General Furayaru's Letter

I405.desc: Beeswax, warmed in the hand. Whatever you don't hear can't get into you. (Covered Ears)
I405.name: Wax Earplugs

I406.desc: Small blood-red jasper scorpions: Mitsue's own Favors. One impossible thing each, from a nobody. Don't waste them on dinner.
I406.name: Jasper Scorpions

I407.desc: Smooth from twenty years in a pocket. Naohida paid for rice cakes with it when they were nine. Tamotsu took it.
I407.name: A Grey Pebble

I408.desc: The tribunal's strongbox notes on eight grievances, in three hands. Tsune's says "Scorpion" in the margin of every page.
I408.name: The Case Notes

I413.desc: The jade mine's last ledger. The final page is an order to close the mine to everyone but the old master's men, in Kurosho's own hand.
I413.name: The Foreman's Ledger

I414.desc: "My son goes to the castle. Bring him home, if there is a home." Folded small, next to the pebble.
I414.name: Nihime's Note

I416.desc: An iron fork that hums one note forever. Karasu says a song sung backwards against it comes out the right way round.
I416.name: Karasu's Tuning Fork

I417.desc: A letter for Kurosho, in a courtesan's perfect hand, carried by a Yotomo pigeon. Three words: Look at me.
I417.name: The Pigeon's Letter

I425.desc: "Payment, Daigoro's band." Stamped with a Sono household seal. The judge's family is paying the murderer's friends.
I425.name: The Sono Chit

I426.desc: A love poem from Mibu Ieko to the poet O-Sode, never delivered. The brushwork is terrible. The feeling isn't.
I426.name: Ieko's Love Poem

I427.desc: Four goblin baskets: offering coins, paper prayers, a bronze bell, a biwa, two large radishes.
I427.name: The Pilgrims' Loot

I430.desc: Jinnai's prayer beads. One bead is a tiny carved snake. "The mountain is yours." The Mountain of the White Snow.
I430.name: Snake Beads

I431.desc: An iron ring from an enforcer's pack, a snake swallowing its tail. Inside the band, very small: "The line must stay true."
I431.name: Snake Ring

I432.desc: An Ikoma travel writ, sealed in gold wax, fluttered off a young lord's saddle. Lion checkpoints wave its bearer through.
I432.name: Sadanobu's Travel Writ

I435.desc: A Yasuki chit, signed with a flourish: "Ten off, for the matchmaker." Floating Flowers shops sell for less.
I435.name: Kanemori's Discount

I437.desc: Iron spikes that strap to straw sandals. Pilfered from an outfitter who charges pilgrims double. The ice ledges hold for them.
I437.name: Climbing Spikes

I438.desc: A baby's rattle of silver, chrysanthemums worked into it, from a frozen nursery. It has not been shaken in three hundred years.
I438.name: Silver Rattle

I440.desc: Two swords, drawn in a few strokes of ink, moving like a storm. Hikaru left it in the snow. Someday a Mirumoto student might read it.
I440.name: Hikaru's Kata Scroll

I441.desc: Lifted from a pilgrim's sleeve. Under the cipher, in a careless hand: "Poison the eta well before the ascension."
I441.name: The Cipher Letter

I442.desc: An iron key as long as a hand, from the old priest who sweeps the lower shrine. The crater shrine's back gate, above the last switchback.
I442.name: Back-gate Key

I443.desc: Old Lion work, a single word cut deep: DUTY. Stolen from Shiro Akodo and nailed to a tree in the Shinomen to be laughed at. Shizue carries it now.
I443.name: "Duty" Plaque

I177.desc: The Phoenix book of every ward against the Bloodspeakers, a hundred years in the writing. One page is marked with a dried camellia petal: "On the Bride of Fu Leng, who wears the faces of the beloved..."
I177.name: "Against the Bloodspeakers"

I168.desc: A Phoenix temple tea. Restores some SP.
I168.name: Rejuvenating Tea

I146.desc: An Asahina ward on a paper strip. Burns the false charms off every enemy.
I146.name: Ward-paper Strip

I148.desc: A Doji crest in silver thread. Sells.
I148.name: Doji Mon Charm

I150.desc: The real jade stone Hojiki bound to his wound, found on the bathhouse floor. Thrown, it burns what possesses the living. (Jade)
I150.name: Hojiki's Jade Stone

I153.desc: Isawa Hoju's tea set. He kept it with his histories. Sells; or a cook in Kamatori might like it back.
I153.name: Hoju's Tea Set

I154.desc: A link of Hoju's jade chain, cracked in the binding. A smith could set it in a blade. (Sells)
I154.name: Jade Chain Fragment

I444.desc: A pearl black as deep water, left in a Naga shrine by someone who once lowered a spear. It remembers the sea. (Sells)
I444.name: Spawn Pearl

I156.desc: A jade-headed flesh-cutter arrow, the history dinner's prize. Thrown by hand if you must. (Jade)
I156.name: Jade Flesh-cutter Arrow

I130.desc: A pinch of jade rubbed into the skin. Cleanses all Taint from one ally.
I130.name: Jade Pouch

I131.desc: A Kaiu field tonic. Restores a great deal of HP.
I131.name: Ginseng Tonic

I161.desc: A Seppun duelist's medicine case. Restores a great deal of HP.
I161.name: Duelist's Inro

I162.desc: A black, glassy blade a "Crane deserter" sold Gusai. It strips a Fear-demon's guard (3 shields). It eats the hand that holds it: every strike Taints the user. (The Jade Finger wards it.)
I162.name: Obsidian Blade

I163.desc: Imperial seal wax, lifted and pressed again more than once. Yachiko's. (Sells)
I163.name: Miya Seal Wax

I170.desc: A bottle of Hioninmaru's tattoo-ink. It burns like oil when thrown, and smells worse. (Fire, one enemy)
I170.name: Bloodspeaker Tattoo-ink

I175.desc: A black pearl from the oni's heart, warm as a fever. Crushed and thrown, it sickens what it hits. (Void, one enemy)
I175.name: Fever-black Pearl

I132.desc: An old Hiruma patrol horn. Sells well to collectors.
I132.name: Signal Horn

I133.desc: A patrol's whetstone, worn hollow. Sells.
I133.name: Old Whetstone

I134.desc: A Hida banner's crab mon, cut free on the road home. Sells.
I134.name: Hida Mon Charm

I135.desc: A breath of bottled storm spirit. Air damage to one enemy.
I135.name: Kansen Mist

I136.desc: It smokes in the jar. Fire damage to one enemy.
I136.name: Oni Ichor

I197.desc: A shard of Miya relic crystal. Crystal cuts what steel only annoys: a Kansen, a spirit. (Crystal damage to one enemy)
I197.name: Crystal Shard

I199.desc: Spring water blessed at Kudo's Inari shrine. Corrupted kami hate clean water. (Water damage to one enemy)
I199.name: Inari Spring Water

I410.desc: A lump of uncut jade from the Iuchi mines, still gritty. Thrown hard, it burns the dead and the Tainted. (Jade damage, one enemy)
I410.name: Raw Jade

I412.desc: A carrot from a woodchuck's hoard. The woodchuck has been informed. Restores a little HP.
I412.name: Carrot

I415.desc: A twist of beeswax. In battle: put the wax back in an ally's ears (Covered Ears again).
I415.name: Spare Wax

I418.desc: Remedy base (Earth): heal. It smells like dirt because it remembers the dirt.
I418.name: Ginseng Root

I419.desc: Remedy base (Water): purge. Cures what's in the blood.
I419.name: Rhubarb

I420.desc: Remedy base (Fire): burst. Firework powder, native herbs, quite legal.
I420.name: Hanabi Powder

I422.desc: Remedy catalyst (Fire): it spreads - to every ally, or every enemy.
I422.name: Moxa

I423.desc: Remedy catalyst (Earth): and a guard (DEF up).
I423.name: Willow Bark

I428.desc: A burning stick from the fire pit. Thrown, it sets things alight. (Fire damage, one enemy)
I428.name: Firebrand

I424.desc: Tomie Cho's tea. It really is very good tea. Restores all HP.
I424.name: Old Woman's Tea

I439.desc: A pounded rice cake from the Village of the Wounded Lion. The villagers leave them on the snow mounds and won't say why. Restores some HP.
I439.name: Rice Cake

I429.desc: Remedy catalyst (Water): it keeps on healing (Regen). From the Phoenix mountains, by way of a Yasuki.
I429.name: Snow-Lotus

I433.desc: A scale of solid shadow from the snake den. Cold. A Yasuki will pay well, and ask nothing.
I433.name: Shadow Scale

I434.desc: A fang still wet with shadow-venom. Sell it. Don't lick it.
I434.name: Shadow-snake Fang

I436.desc: Mountain honey in a stoppered gourd. With willow bark, Ume-baa's cure for a cough that won't go.
I436.name: Wild Honey

I409.desc: Gaijin pepper in a clay pot, a fuse in the neck. Forbidden by the Emperor. (Fire damage, all enemies)
I409.name: Powder Bomb

I400.desc: A shadow hunter's rosary of crystal beads, flung apart. (Crystal damage, all enemies)
I400.name: Crystal Rosary

I198.desc: A Shosuro clay pellet of soot and pepper. (Blind chance, all enemies)
I198.name: Smoke Pellet

I185.desc: A lacquered theatre mask from the Kyuden Bayushi mask-maker. Sells well anywhere there is a stage.
I185.name: Actor's Mask

I186.desc: Somebody's purse, stolen by a bandit, stolen back. Sells.
I186.name: Bandit's Purse

I137.desc: Her father's map, the first leg marked in charcoal. Kage carries it now.
I137.name: Map of the Road Home

I138.desc: A rib from Oni no Tsukakoro's cage, still warm. Kaiu smiths pay well for it.
I138.name: Bone-cage Fragment

I237.desc: Purifying salt, the Shinto way. Cleanses all Taint from one ally.
I237.name: Sea Salt

I445.desc: Burned before a prayer. Restores some MP.
I445.name: Sakaki Incense

I446.desc: Blessed at a great shrine. Restores a good deal of MP.
I446.name: Temple Incense

I447.desc: Strong enough to stand a spoon in. Restores some TP.
I447.name: Bitter Green Tea

I448.desc: One cup before the charge. Restores a good deal of TP.
I448.name: Warrior's Sake
